title: Rabbi Acha bar Gamda
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At the end of [Yalkut Shimoni on Mishlei, remez 932](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.932.21), Rabbi Acha bar Gamda cites Rabbi Simai for the verse “The discipline [of the Lord]…,” etc. Hyman calls the attribution a scribal error and traces it to [Megillah 31b](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.31b.6), where Rabbi Chiyya bar Gamda speaks in Rabbi Assi’s name, and so it is in Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:5, Rabbi Chiyya bar Gamda.

notes.text: [Yalkut Shimoni 932:21](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.932.21) and [Megillah 31b:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.31b.6) both cite Proverbs 3:11 about reading the curses without interruption, but give different names for both links in the chain. Hyman’s proposed derivation is his textual judgment.
